mapper.select: SELECT domestic_product_id FROM domestic_product WHERE ticker=#{ticker} ORDER BY domestic_product_id FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM stock_risk_grade WHERE domestic_product_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT g.domestic_product_id, p.ticker, g.var_975, g.risk_grade, g.volatility, g.price_from, g.price_to, g.calculated_at, g.synced_at, g.analysis_version FROM stock_risk_grade g JOIN domestic_product p ON p.domestic_product_id=g.domestic_product_id ORDER BY g.domestic_product_id
